description:
Media Player Classic - BE is a free and open source audio and video player for Windows.


AudioSplitter
Potential crashes have been fixed.
Added partial support for AIFF-C files.
MpaDecFilter
Fixed AC3 audio encoding for S/PDIF and HDMI output.
MPCVideoDec
Fixed DolbyVision support for D3D11cb, D3D12cb and NVDEC decoders.
VideoRenderers
Added support for FrankyRenderer (https://github.com/mryx007/FrankyRenderer).
Player
Various interface fixes.
Installer
Updated MPC Video Renderer 0.11.1.
Updated Slovak translation.
Updated German translation (by Klaus1189).
Updated Romanian translation (by Andrei Miloiu).
Updated Chinese (Simplified) translation (by wushantao).
Updated Hungarian translation (by mickey).
Updated Turkish translation (by cmhrky).
